search_damping_audit.method: Equivalent Cartesian control forces from the recorded Jacobian and actual joint torque/velocity; this is a counterfactual control-load calculation, not a measured new contact force.

landing_load_reference_audit.description: Support loads scale the GRF. Passive and active joint damping were unscaled, so multiplying only D*q_reference by load reintroduced nominal drag during confirmation ramp. Keep the reference matched to its unscaled damping gain, gated by actual confirmed contact; final force load and torque bounds unchanged.
